limitations: Separate 10-call profiles do not replace the primary 1000-call means or six independent pairs.
PDL stage durations overlap; stage sums are not a serial latency estimate.
Merge duration includes generation polling and reduction; no separate spin counter was measured.
Transport is same-node CUDA symmetric-memory peer writes over NV36. No inter-node or link-bandwidth measurement was performed.
K_fixed, R_fixed and B_fixed all include the declared shared-memory ordering fence. Original defective references are preserved separately.
